user_directive: When you’re done this round we are going to change our optimization procedure: closest parity first. Target the optimization benchmark which has the closest parity to C and optimize that one until it’s 1x C, then continue on from there making sure to maintain those wins.
supersedes: Largest remaining optimization-set margin as target-selection priority; no retrospective decision changes.

policy.selection_metric: kernel median Mech runtime / C runtime using unchanged frozen evaluation
policy.choose_target: Among optimization benchmarks above1.0x in the latest accepted run, choose the smallest Mech/C ratio. Stable protocol order breaks exact ties.
policy.target_lock: Profile and optimize that active target until an accepted complete formal evaluation records it at<=1.0x C; do not switch merely because another unfinished case becomes closer.
policy.advance: After active target reaches<=1.0x C, add all newly attained optimization parity cases to maintained wins and choose the closest remaining unfinished case using that accepted run.
policy.maintain_wins: Retain every attained optimization-set<=1.0x C result as a future promotion requirement. Record the attaining round/source/driver/ratio and check all previously attained cases in every later complete formal run.
policy.compiler_scope: General shared compiler/native optimizations from source semantics; unchanged idiomatic ports and inputs; no benchmark-name or MINI-shape rules.
policy.selection_and_qualification: Keep the existing optimization-only aggregate strict-improvement gate and complete correctness/source/resource qualification. A prospective candidate must target this active case; gains elsewhere do not justify changing the active target.
policy.holdout_use: Report the complete holdout aggregate independently. Never choose, diagnose, tune, select, veto, roll back or retry from holdout results.
policy.reporting: Continue both optimization15 and holdout15 equal-weight geometric-mean Mech/C, target ratio and raw Mech speedup, attained parity wins, controls and all regressions.
policy.measurement_discipline: Keep the single prospective qualified-fingerprint probe, one frozen formal evaluation, no retiming/exclusions, immutable history, exact source bills or independently proved physical reductions, no Rust edits while build/profile/timing live.
